f.title: Communicate to the ANPD and to data subjects any security incident that may cause relevant risk or damage
f.statement: The controller must communicate to the ANPD and to the data subject the occurrence of any security incident that may cause relevant risk or damage to the data subjects.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter III, Section I, Art. 4 (Criteria for communicating a security incident)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.quote: Art. 4º O controlador deverá comunicar à ANPD e ao titular a ocorrência de incidente de segurança que possa acarretar risco ou dano relevante aos titulares.
rows.location: Annex, Chapter III, Section I, Art. 4 (Criteria for communicating a security incident)
rows.review_note: Review: deverá = shall; Mandatory. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: quote proves actor, recipients and trigger.
rows.quote_en: Art. 4. The controller shall communicate to the ANPD and to the data subject the occurrence of a security incident that may cause relevant risk or damage to the data subjects.

f.title: Assess whether an incident may cause relevant risk or damage using the Art. 5 criteria (sensitive, children's or elderly people's, large-scale data, etc.)
f.statement: To decide whether communication is required, the controller must assess whether the security incident may significantly affect the data subjects' interests and fundamental rights and, cumulatively, involves at least one of: sensitive personal data (which include health data); data of children, adolescents or elderly people; financial data; system authentication data; data protected by legal, judicial or professional secrecy; or large-scale data.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter III, Section I, Art. 5, caput (Relevant risk or damage)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.exceptions: § 1 and § 2 illustrate significant effects (e.g. preventing the exercise of rights, discrimination, identity theft) and large scale (number of data subjects, volume, duration, frequency, geography).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.location: Annex, Chapter III, Section I, Art. 5, caput (Relevant risk or damage)
data_elements: data of children, adolescents or elderly
rows.review_note: Review: definition kept because it sets the scope of the Art. 4 communication duty; stated as the assessment duty; Mandatory (binding regulation). Translation check: agrees. Double-check: statement adds only that health data are sensitive (LGPD definition), flagged in the statement.
rows.quote_en: Art. 5. A security incident may cause relevant risk or damage to data subjects when it may significantly affect the data subjects' interests and fundamental rights and, cumulatively, involves at least one of the following criteria: I - sensitive personal data; II - data of children, adolescents or elderly persons; III - financial data; IV - system authentication data; V - data protected by legal, judicial or professional secrecy; or VI - large-scale data.

f.title: Communicate the incident to the ANPD within 3 business days of knowing that personal data were affected
f.statement: The controller must communicate the security incident to the ANPD within three business days, counted from the controller's knowledge that the incident affected personal data, unless specific legislation sets another communication deadline.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter III, Section II, Art. 6, caput and § 1 (Communication to the ANPD)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.exceptions: A communication deadline set in specific legislation prevails. Deadline counted in double for small-scale processing agents (agentes de tratamento de pequeno porte) under Res. CD/ANPD 2/2022 (Art. 6 § 8 and Art. 9 § 6).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.deadline: 3 business days from the controller's knowledge that the incident affected personal data (doubled for small-scale processing agents)
rows.quote:
Art. 6º A comunicação de incidente de segurança à ANPD deverá ser realizada pelo controlador no prazo de três dias úteis, ressalvada a existência de prazo para comunicação previsto em legislação específica.
 § 1º O prazo a que se refere o caput será contado do conhecimento pelo controlador de que o incidente afetou dados pessoais.
rows.location: Annex, Chapter III, Section II, Art. 6, caput and § 1 (Communication to the ANPD)
data_elements: date of knowledge of the incident
rows.review_note: Review: deverá = shall; deadline 3 dias úteis = 3 business days from knowledge (§ 1). Translation check: agrees. Double-check: deadline_rule clock_start copied verbatim.
rows.quote_en: Art. 6. The communication of a security incident to the ANPD shall be made by the controller within three business days, save where a communication deadline is provided in specific legislation. § 1 The period referred to in the caput shall be counted from the controller's knowledge that the incident affected personal data.

deadline_rule.clock_start: do conhecimento pelo controlador de que o incidente afetou dados pessoais
deadline_rule.applies_to: communication of a security incident to the ANPD

f.title: ANPD communication content (I-VI): data affected, number of data subjects, security measures, risks, reasons for delay, mitigation
f.statement: The communication to the ANPD must contain: (I) a description of the nature and category of the affected personal data; (II) the number of affected data subjects, specifying the number of children, adolescents or elderly people where applicable; (III) the technical and security measures used to protect the personal data, adopted before and after the incident, subject to trade and industrial secrets; (IV) the risks of the incident, identifying the possible impacts on data subjects; (V) the reasons for the delay, if the communication was not made within the 3-business-day deadline; and (VI) the measures taken or to be taken to reverse or mitigate the effects of the incident on data subjects.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter III, Section II, Art. 6, § 2, items I-VI (Content of the communication)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.location: Annex, Chapter III, Section II, Art. 6, § 2, items I-VI (Content of the communication)
data_elements: nature and category of affected personal data
number of children, adolescents or elderly
security measures before and after the incident
rows.review_note: Review: § 2 split in two rows because the whole list exceeds the 1000-character quote limit; this row carries the lead-in 'deverá conter' (shall contain). Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: § 2 The communication of a security incident shall contain the following information: I - a description of the nature and category of the affected personal data; II - the number of affected data subjects, specifying, where applicable, the number of children, adolescents or elderly persons; III - the technical and security measures used to protect the personal data, adopted before and after the incident, subject to commercial and industrial secrets; IV - the risks related to the incident, identifying the possible impacts on data subjects; V - the reasons for the delay, if the communication was not made within the period in the caput of this article; VI - the measures that were or will be adopted to reverse or mitigate the effects of the incident on the data subjects;

f.title: ANPD communication content (VII-XII): incident dates, DPO details, controller and processor identity, cause, total data subjects
f.statement: The communication to the ANPD must also contain: (VII) the date of the incident, where it can be determined, and the date the controller became aware of it; (VIII) the details of the DPO (encarregado) or of whoever represents the controller; (IX) the identification of the controller and, where relevant, a statement that it is a small-scale processing agent; (X) the identification of the processor, where applicable; (XI) the description of the incident, including the main cause where it can be identified; and (XII) the total number of data subjects whose data are processed in the processing activities affected by the incident.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter III, Section II, Art. 6, § 2, items VII-XII (Content of the communication)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.location: Annex, Chapter III, Section II, Art. 6, § 2, items VII-XII (Content of the communication)
data_elements: total data subjects in affected processing
rows.review_note: Review: second half of the § 2 list; the operative 'deverá conter' is in the lead-in quoted in the previous row (same paragraph, contiguous). Translation check: agrees. Double-check: quote lacks the modal itself, so 88.
rows.quote_en: VII - the date of the incident, where it can be determined, and the date the controller became aware of it; VIII - the details of the data protection officer or of whoever represents the controller; IX - the identification of the controller and, where applicable, a declaration that it is a small-scale processing agent; X - the identification of the processor, where applicable; XI - a description of the incident, including the main cause, if it can be identified; and XII - the total number of data subjects whose data are processed in the processing activities affected by the incident.

f.title: Supplement the ANPD communication with justified additional information within 20 business days
f.statement: The controller may supplement the information in the communication, with justification, within twenty business days from the date of the communication.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter III, Section II, Art. 6, § 3 (Supplementary information)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.exceptions: Deadline counted in double for small-scale processing agents (agentes de tratamento de pequeno porte) under Res. CD/ANPD 2/2022 (Art. 6 § 8 and Art. 9 § 6).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.deadline: 20 business days from the date of the communication (doubled for small-scale processing agents)
rows.quote: § 3º As informações poderão ser complementadas, de maneira fundamentada, no prazo de vinte dias úteis, a contar da data da comunicação.
rows.location: Annex, Chapter III, Section II, Art. 6, § 3 (Supplementary information)
rows.review_note: Review: poderão = may; Permitted. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: deadline and clock start verbatim.
rows.quote_en: § 3 The information may be supplemented, in a reasoned manner, within twenty business days from the date of the communication.

deadline_rule.clock_start: a contar da data da comunicação
deadline_rule.applies_to: supplementary information to an incident communication

f.title: Submit the incident communication through the ANPD electronic form
f.statement: The communication of a security incident must be made through the electronic form made available by the ANPD.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter III, Section II, Art. 6, § 4 (Channel)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.quote: § 4º A comunicação de incidente de segurança deverá ocorrer por meio de formulário eletrônico disponibilizado pela ANPD.
rows.location: Annex, Chapter III, Section II, Art. 6, § 4 (Channel)
rows.review_note: Review: deverá = shall. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: § 4 The communication of a security incident shall take place by means of the electronic form made available by the ANPD.

f.title: File the communication through the DPO or a constituted representative, with proof of authority, within the 3-business-day deadline
f.statement: The controller must make the communication through its data protection officer (encarregado), accompanied by a document proving the contractual, employment or functional link, or through a constituted representative, accompanied by an instrument granting powers of representation before the ANPD. These documents must be submitted together with the communication, within the deadline of Art. 6 caput (3 business days). If they are not, the ANPD may investigate the incident through the incident investigation procedure.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter III, Section II, Art. 6, §§ 5-7 (Who communicates; supporting documents)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.exceptions: Deadline counted in double for small-scale processing agents (agentes de tratamento de pequeno porte) under Res. CD/ANPD 2/2022 (Art. 6 § 8 and Art. 9 § 6).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Controller (through its DPO or a constituted representative)
rows.deadline: Together with the communication, within 3 business days of knowing that the incident affected personal data
rows.quote:
§ 5º A comunicação de incidente de segurança deverá ser realizada pelo controlador, por meio do encarregado, acompanhada de documento comprobatório de vínculo contratual, empregatício ou funcional, ou por meio de representante constituído, acompanhada de instrumento com poderes de representação junto à ANPD.
 § 6º Os documentos de que trata o § 5º deverão ser apresentados juntamente com a comunicação do incidente de segurança, no prazo previsto no caput deste artigo.
 § 7º No caso de descumprimento do previsto no § 6º, a ANPD poderá apurar a ocorrência do incidente de segurança por meio do procedimento de apuração de incidente de segurança.
rows.location: Annex, Chapter III, Section II, Art. 6, §§ 5-7 (Who communicates; supporting documents)
rows.review_note: Review: deverá/deverão = shall; § 7 consequence kept with the duty. deadline_rule clock start is the Art. 6 § 1 wording that § 6 refers to ('prazo previsto no caput'). Translation check: agrees. Double-check: clock start not in this quote but in Art. 6 § 1, which § 6 cites.
rows.quote_en: § 5 The communication of a security incident shall be made by the controller, through the data protection officer, accompanied by a document proving the contractual, employment or functional link, or through a constituted representative, accompanied by an instrument with powers of representation before the ANPD. § 6 The documents referred to in § 5 shall be submitted together with the communication of the security incident, within the period provided in the caput of this article. § 7 In the event of non-compliance with § 6, the ANPD may investigate the occurrence of the security incident by means of the security incident investigation procedure.

deadline_rule.clock_start: do conhecimento pelo controlador de que o incidente afetou dados pessoais
deadline_rule.applies_to: documents proving the DPO's link or the representative's powers

f.title: Request confidentiality of legally protected information (e.g. trade secrets) in the communication, with justification
f.statement: It is incumbent on the controller to request the ANPD, with justification, to keep confidential the information protected by law that it submits, indicating which information must have restricted access (for example information on its business activity whose disclosure could breach trade or industrial secrets). If the controller wants such information protected, it must make this reasoned request; the ANPD does not restrict access on its own initiative under this article.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter III, Section II, Art. 7 (Confidentiality request)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Audit & inspection readiness

rows.quote: Art. 7º Cabe ao controlador solicitar à ANPD, de maneira fundamentada, o sigilo de informações protegidas por lei, indicando aquelas cujo acesso deverá ser restringido, a exemplo das relativas à sua atividade empresarial cuja divulgação possa representar violação de segredo comercial ou industrial.
rows.location: Annex, Chapter III, Section II, Art. 7 (Confidentiality request)
rows.review_note: Review: 'cabe ao controlador solicitar' = it is incumbent on the controller to request; obligation wording without a 'may', so Mandatory (audit rule), with the condition (only where protected information is submitted and confidentiality is wanted) stated. The last sentence of the statement is an inference from the article's wording. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: conditional duty; 86.
rows.quote_en: Art. 7. It is for the controller to request from the ANPD, in a reasoned manner, the confidentiality of information protected by law, indicating that whose access shall be restricted, such as information relating to its business activity whose disclosure could represent a breach of commercial or industrial secrecy.

f.title: When the ANPD requests it, provide additional incident information, including the processing records, DPIA and incident handling report, within the deadline set
f.statement: The ANPD may at any time request additional information on the security incident from the controller, including the record of processing operations for the affected personal data, the data protection impact assessment (RIPD) and the incident handling report, setting a deadline for sending it. When so requested, the controller must provide the information within that deadline.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter III, Section II, Art. 8 (Additional information)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Audit & inspection readiness

rows.deadline: Within the deadline set by the ANPD in its request
rows.quote: Art. 8º A ANPD poderá, a qualquer tempo, solicitar informações adicionais ao controlador, referentes ao incidente de segurança, inclusive o registro das operações de tratamento dos dados pessoais afetados pelo incidente, o relatório de impacto à proteção de dados pessoais (RIPD) e o relatório de tratamento do incidente, estabelecendo prazo para o envio das informações.
rows.location: Annex, Chapter III, Section II, Art. 8 (Additional information)
rows.review_note: Review: authority power over the controller (poderá solicitar) recorded as a conditional company duty; level Permitted follows the source modal, statement worded 'when requested'. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: conditional duty, not plain Mandatory.
rows.quote_en: Art. 8. The ANPD may, at any time, request additional information from the controller concerning the security incident, including the record of processing operations of the personal data affected by the incident, the personal data protection impact assessment report (RIPD) and the incident handling report, setting a deadline for sending the information.

f.title: Communicate the incident to affected data subjects within 3 business days of knowing that personal data were affected
f.statement: The controller must communicate the security incident to the data subject within three business days, counted from the controller's knowledge that the incident affected personal data, and the communication must contain the information listed in Art. 9 (see the next requirement).
f.clause: Annex, Chapter III, Section III, Art. 9, caput (Communication to the data subject)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.exceptions: Deadline counted in double for small-scale processing agents (agentes de tratamento de pequeno porte) under Res. CD/ANPD 2/2022 (Art. 6 § 8 and Art. 9 § 6).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.deadline: 3 business days from the controller's knowledge that the incident affected personal data (doubled for small-scale processing agents)
rows.quote: Art. 9º A comunicação de incidente de segurança ao titular deverá ser realizada pelo controlador no prazo de três dias úteis contados do conhecimento pelo controlador de que o incidente afetou dados pessoais, e deverá conter as seguintes informações:
rows.location: Annex, Chapter III, Section III, Art. 9, caput (Communication to the data subject)
data_elements: date of knowledge of the incident
rows.review_note: Review: deverá = shall; caput split from its list (quote limit). Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: Art. 9. The communication of a security incident to the data subject shall be made by the controller within three business days counted from the controller's knowledge that the incident affected personal data, and shall contain the following information:

deadline_rule.applies_to: communication of a security incident to data subjects

f.title: Include the 7 required items in the communication to data subjects
f.statement: The communication to the data subject must contain: (I) the nature and category of the affected personal data; (II) the technical and security measures used to protect the data, subject to trade and industrial secrets; (III) the risks of the incident with the possible impacts on data subjects; (IV) the reasons for any delay; (V) the measures taken or to be taken to reverse or mitigate the effects, where applicable; (VI) the date the incident became known; and (VII) the contact point for information and, where applicable, the DPO's contact details.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter III, Section III, Art. 9, items I-VII (Content of the communication to data subjects)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.location: Annex, Chapter III, Section III, Art. 9, items I-VII (Content of the communication to data subjects)
data_elements: nature and category of affected personal data
rows.review_note: Review: deverá conter = shall contain; list quoted from the end of the caput. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: and shall contain the following information: I - a description of the nature and category of the affected personal data; II - the technical and security measures used to protect the data, subject to commercial and industrial secrets; III - the risks related to the incident, identifying the possible impacts on data subjects; IV - the reasons for the delay, if the communication was not made within the period in the caput of this article; V - the measures that were or will be adopted to reverse or mitigate the effects of the incident, where applicable; VI - the date on which the security incident became known; and VII - the contact for obtaining information and, where applicable, the contact details of the data protection officer.

f.title: Use plain language and direct, individual communication to data subjects where they can be identified
f.statement: The communication of the incident to data subjects must use simple, easily understood language and be made directly and individually where the data subjects can be identified, i.e. through the means the controller usually uses to contact them (such as telephone, e-mail, electronic message or letter).
f.clause: Annex, Chapter III, Section III, Art. 9, §§ 1-2 (Form of communication to data subjects)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.quote:
§ 1º A comunicação do incidente aos titulares de dados deverá atender aos seguintes critérios:
 I - fazer uso de linguagem simples e de fácil entendimento; e
 II - ocorrer de forma direta e individualizada, caso seja possível identificá-los.
 § 2º Considera-se comunicação de forma direta e individualizada aquela realizada pelos meios usualmente utilizados pelo controlador para contatar o titular, tais como telefone, e-mail, mensagem eletrônica ou carta.
rows.location: Annex, Chapter III, Section III, Art. 9, §§ 1-2 (Form of communication to data subjects)
rows.review_note: Review: deverá = shall. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: § 1 The communication of the incident to data subjects shall meet the following criteria: I - use simple and easily understood language; and II - take place directly and individually, if it is possible to identify them. § 2 Direct and individualised communication is that made through the means usually used by the controller to contact the data subject, such as telephone, e-mail, electronic message or letter.

f.title: Where direct communication is not feasible, publish the incident on the controller's channels for at least 3 months
f.statement: Where direct and individual communication is unfeasible, or the affected data subjects cannot be wholly or partly identified, the controller must communicate the incident, within the Art. 9 deadline and with the Art. 9 information, through the publicity means available to it (such as its website, apps, social media and data subject service channels), so that the communication allows broad awareness, with direct and easy visibility, for a period of at least three months.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter III, Section III, Art. 9, § 3 (Public communication)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.exceptions: Deadline counted in double for small-scale processing agents (agentes de tratamento de pequeno porte) under Res. CD/ANPD 2/2022 (Art. 6 § 8 and Art. 9 § 6).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.deadline: Within the Art. 9 deadline (3 business days from knowledge); publication kept for at least 3 months
rows.quote: § 3º Caso a comunicação direta e individualizada mostre-se inviável ou não seja possível identificar, parcial ou integralmente, os titulares afetados, o controlador deverá comunicar a ocorrência do incidente, no prazo e com as informações definidas no caput, pelos meios de divulgação disponíveis, tais como seu sítio eletrônico, aplicativos, suas mídias sociais e canais de atendimento ao titular, de modo que a comunicação permita o conhecimento amplo, com direta e fácil visualização, pelo período de, no mínimo, três meses.
rows.location: Annex, Chapter III, Section III, Art. 9, § 3 (Public communication)
rows.review_note: Review: deverá = shall; 'no prazo ... definidas no caput' ties the 3-business-day deadline (Art. 9 caput clock start used); the 3-month minimum is a display period, not a deadline. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: § 3 If direct and individualised communication proves unfeasible or it is not possible to identify, partially or fully, the affected data subjects, the controller shall communicate the occurrence of the incident, within the period and with the information defined in the caput, through the available means of publicity, such as its website, applications, its social media and data subject service channels, so that the communication allows broad knowledge, with direct and easy visibility, for a period of at least three months.

deadline_rule.clock_start: contados do conhecimento pelo controlador de que o incidente afetou dados pessoais
deadline_rule.applies_to: public communication when direct communication to data subjects is not feasible

f.title: File with the ANPD a declaration that data subjects were informed within 3 business days after the data-subject deadline
f.statement: The controller must add to the incident communication process a declaration that the communication to data subjects was made, stating the means of communication or publicity used, within three business days counted from the end of the Art. 9 deadline for communicating to data subjects.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter III, Section III, Art. 9, § 4 (Declaration of communication to data subjects)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.deadline: Within 3 business days from the end of the Art. 9 deadline
rows.quote: § 4º O controlador deverá juntar ao processo de comunicação de incidente uma declaração de que foi realizada a comunicação aos titulares, constando os meios de comunicação ou divulgação utilizados, em até três dias úteis, contados do término do prazo de que trata o caput deste artigo.
rows.location: Annex, Chapter III, Section III, Art. 9, § 4 (Declaration of communication to data subjects)
rows.review_note: Review: deverá = shall. § 6 doubles only the Art. 9 caput period, so no doubling stated for § 4. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: § 4 The controller shall attach to the incident communication process a declaration that the communication to the data subjects was made, stating the means of communication or publicity used, within up to three business days, counted from the end of the period referred to in the caput of this article.

deadline_rule.clock_start: contados do término do prazo de que trata o caput deste artigo
deadline_rule.applies_to: declaration to the ANPD that data subjects were informed

f.title: Consider including recommendations to reverse or mitigate the incident's effects in the communication to data subjects (good practice)
f.statement: Including, in the communication to data subjects, recommendations capable of reversing or mitigating the effects of the incident may be considered good practice for the purposes of LGPD Art. 52 § 1 IX (a mitigating factor in sanctions).
f.clause: Annex, Chapter III, Section III, Art. 9, § 5 (Good practice)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.quote: § 5º Poderá ser considerada boa prática, para fins do disposto no art. 52, § 1º, IX, da LGPD, a inclusão, na comunicação ao titular, de recomendações aptas a reverter ou mitigar os efeitos do incidente.
rows.location: Annex, Chapter III, Section III, Art. 9, § 5 (Good practice)
rows.review_note: Review: 'poderá ser considerada boa prática' is a recommendation, not a permission; Recommended. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: level judgement accepted.
rows.quote_en: § 5 The inclusion, in the communication to the data subject, of recommendations capable of reversing or mitigating the effects of the incident may be considered good practice for the purposes of art. 52, § 1, IX, of the LGPD.

f.title: Keep a record of every security incident, including those not communicated, for at least 5 years
f.statement: The controller must keep a record of every security incident, including incidents not communicated to the ANPD and data subjects, for at least five years from the date of the record, unless additional obligations require a longer retention period.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter IV, Art. 10, caput (Record of the security incident)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.exceptions: Longer retention where additional obligations require it. § 2: the retention periods do not apply to the public-sector entities of LGPD Art. 23 that follow permanent-retention rules.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.quote: Art. 10. O controlador deverá manter o registro do incidente de segurança, inclusive daquele não comunicado à ANPD e aos titulares, pelo prazo mínimo de cinco anos, contado a partir da data do registro, exceto se constatadas obrigações adicionais que demandem maior prazo de manutenção.
rows.location: Annex, Chapter IV, Art. 10, caput (Record of the security incident)
rows.review_note: Review: deverá = shall; the 5-year minimum is a retention period, so no deadline_rule. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: Art. 10. The controller shall keep the record of the security incident, including one not communicated to the ANPD and to data subjects, for a minimum period of five years, counted from the date of the record, unless additional obligations requiring a longer retention period are found.

f.title: Include the minimum content in each incident record (date of knowledge, circumstances, data, data subjects, risk, measures, communication or reasons for none)
f.statement: The incident record must contain at least: (I) the date the incident became known; (II) a general description of the circumstances; (III) the nature and category of the affected data; (IV) the number of affected data subjects; (V) the risk assessment and possible harm to data subjects; (VI) the correction and mitigation measures, where applicable; (VII) the form and content of the communication, if the incident was communicated to the ANPD and data subjects; and (VIII) the reasons for not communicating, where applicable.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter IV, Art. 10, § 1 (Content of the incident record)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.location: Annex, Chapter IV, Art. 10, § 1 (Content of the incident record)
data_elements: nature and category of affected data
rows.review_note: Review: deverá = shall. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: § 1 The incident record shall contain, at a minimum: I - the date of knowledge of the incident; II - a general description of the circumstances in which the incident occurred; III - the nature and category of the affected data; IV - the number of affected data subjects; V - the risk assessment and the possible harm to data subjects; VI - the measures to correct and mitigate the effects of the incident, where applicable; VII - the form and content of the communication, if the incident was communicated to the ANPD and to data subjects; and VIII - the reasons for the absence of communication, where applicable.

f.title: Be ready for ANPD audits or inspections in an incident communication process
f.statement: The ANPD may at any time carry out, or order, audits or inspections of processing agents to collect complementary information or validate the information received in an incident communication process. The controller must be prepared to support such audits or inspections when the ANPD carries them out or orders them.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter V, Section I, Art. 12 (Audits and inspections)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Data integrity & records

rows.actor: Processing agents (controller and processor), when the ANPD audits or inspects
rows.quote: Art. 12. A ANPD poderá, a qualquer momento, realizar auditorias ou inspeções junto aos agentes de tratamento, ou determinar a sua realização, para coletar informações complementares ou validar as informações recebidas, com o objetivo de subsidiar as decisões no âmbito do processo de comunicação de incidente de segurança.
rows.location: Annex, Chapter V, Section I, Art. 12 (Audits and inspections)
rows.review_note: Review: authority power kept for inspection readiness (conditional company duty); level Permitted follows 'poderá'. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: statement's readiness duty is implied, not stated; 85.
rows.quote_en: Art. 12. The ANPD may, at any time, carry out audits or inspections of processing agents, or order them to be carried out, in order to collect complementary information or validate the information received, with the aim of supporting decisions within the security incident communication process.

f.title: Adopt immediately the preventive measures the ANPD orders during the incident process (daily fine possible)
f.statement: During the incident communication process, the ANPD may order the controller, with or without hearing it first, to adopt immediately the preventive measures needed to safeguard data subjects' rights, to prevent, mitigate or reverse the effects of the incident and avoid serious and irreparable harm. The ANPD may set a daily fine to ensure compliance. When ordered, the controller must adopt the measures immediately.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter V, Section I, Art. 15 (Preventive measures)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Audit & inspection readiness

rows.quote:
Art. 15. No curso do processo de comunicação de incidente de segurança, a ANPD poderá determinar ao controlador, com ou sem a sua prévia manifestação, a adoção imediata de medidas preventivas necessárias para salvaguardar direitos dos titulares, a fim de prevenir, mitigar ou reverter os efeitos do incidente e evitar a ocorrência de dano grave e irreparável ou de difícil reparação.
 Parágrafo único. A ANPD poderá fixar multa diária para assegurar o cumprimento da determinação prevista no caput, na forma do Regulamento de Dosimetria e Aplicação de Sanções Administrativas, aprovado pela Resolução CD/ANPD nº 4, de 24 de fevereiro de 2023 .
rows.location: Annex, Chapter V, Section I, Art. 15 (Preventive measures)
rows.review_note: Review: authority power over the controller (poderá determinar) recorded as a conditional duty with Permitted level; 'adoção imediata' gives the timing, no numeric rule. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: conditional; 86.
rows.quote_en: Art. 15. In the course of the security incident communication process, the ANPD may order the controller, with or without its prior statement, to adopt immediately the preventive measures necessary to safeguard data subjects' rights, in order to prevent, mitigate or reverse the effects of the incident and avoid the occurrence of serious and irreparable or hard-to-repair harm. Sole paragraph. The ANPD may set a daily fine to ensure compliance with the order in the caput, in the form of the Regulation on Dosimetry and Application of Administrative Sanctions, approved by Resolution CD/ANPD No. 4 of 24 February 2023.

f.title: When the ANPD finds an uncommunicated incident, send the communications to the ANPD and data subjects within the Art. 6 and 9 deadlines
f.statement: Where the ANPD, in its incident investigation procedure, confirms that a security incident occurred that the controller did not communicate, it will order the controller to send the communication to the ANPD and to the data subjects, observing the deadlines and conditions of Arts. 6 and 9. The controller must then communicate; the ANPD may also open a sanctioning procedure for the breach of Arts. 6 and 9.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter V, Section II, Art. 17 (Incident investigation procedure)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Controller (on ANPD order after an investigation)
rows.deadline: Within the Art. 6 and Art. 9 deadlines (3 business days)
rows.quote:
Art. 17. Constatada a ocorrência de incidente de segurança, a ANPD determinará ao controlador o envio da comunicação à Autoridade e aos titulares, observados os prazos e condições descritos nos arts. 6º e 9º deste Regulamento, respectivamente.
 § 1º A ANPD poderá, ainda, instaurar processo administrativo sancionador para apurar o descumprimento do previsto nos arts. 6º e 9º deste Regulamento.
rows.location: Annex, Chapter V, Section II, Art. 17 (Incident investigation procedure)
rows.review_note: Review: 'determinará' is the ANPD's own duty; the controller's duty is conditional on the order, worded 'when ordered'. Kept Mandatory because the order binds without discretion and the Art. 6/9 duties already apply. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: conditional duty; 88.
rows.quote_en: Art. 17. Once the occurrence of a security incident has been established, the ANPD shall order the controller to send the communication to the Authority and to the data subjects, observing the deadlines and conditions described in arts. 6 and 9 of this Regulation, respectively. § 1 The ANPD may also open an administrative sanctioning proceeding to investigate non-compliance with arts. 6 and 9 of this Regulation.

f.title: Carry out the broad media disclosure and mitigation measures the ANPD orders, at the controller's expense
f.statement: After assessing the severity of the incident, the ANPD may order the controller to adopt measures to safeguard data subjects' rights, such as broad disclosure of the incident in the media and measures to reverse or mitigate its effects. The ANPD may order broad disclosure at the controller's expense when the controller's own communication proved insufficient to reach a significant share of the affected data subjects. When so ordered, the controller must carry out the measures.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter V, Section III, Art. 19, caput and § 3 (Measures ordered by the ANPD)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Safety communications

rows.quote: § 3º A ANPD poderá determinar ampla divulgação do incidente em meios de comunicação, às expensas do controlador, para a salvaguarda dos direitos dos titulares, nos termos do art. 48, § 2º, I, da LGPD, quando a comunicação realizada pelo controlador mostrar-se insuficiente para alcançar parcela significativa dos titulares afetados pelo incidente.
rows.location: Annex, Chapter V, Section III, Art. 19, caput and § 3 (Measures ordered by the ANPD)
rows.review_note: Review: authority power (poderá determinar) as conditional duty; Permitted. The caput's measure list is summarised in the statement from Art. 19 caput, the quote is § 3. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: caput content not in the quote; 85.
rows.quote_en: § 3 The ANPD may order broad disclosure of the incident in the media, at the controller's expense, to safeguard data subjects' rights, under art. 48, § 2, I, of the LGPD, when the communication made by the controller proves insufficient to reach a significant share of the data subjects affected by the incident.

f.title: Adopt the mitigation measures the ANPD orders within its deadline, or face a sanctioning procedure
f.statement: If the controller does not adopt the measures to reverse or mitigate the effects of the security incident within the deadline and under the conditions set by the ANPD, the ANPD may open an administrative sanctioning proceeding. The controller must therefore adopt ordered measures within the ANPD's deadline.
f.clause: Annex, Chapter V, Section III, Art. 21 (Sanctioning procedure)
f.applicability: Brazil; Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15 of 24 April 2024, Annex (Security Incident Communication Regulation) under LGPD Art. 48. Applies to a pharma company as controller of personal data, e.g. ICSR, patient-support or clinical-trial safety data (health data are sensitive data).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Audit & inspection readiness

rows.deadline: Within the deadline set by the ANPD
rows.quote: Art. 21. A ANPD poderá instaurar processo administrativo sancionador caso o controlador não adote as medidas para reverter ou mitigar os efeitos do incidente de segurança no prazo e nas condições determinadas pela Autoridade.
rows.location: Annex, Chapter V, Section III, Art. 21 (Sanctioning procedure)
rows.review_note: Review: sanction tied to the controller's incident-mitigation duty; Permitted follows 'poderá'. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: conditional duty; 86.
rows.quote_en: Art. 21. The ANPD may open an administrative sanctioning proceeding if the controller does not adopt the measures to reverse or mitigate the effects of the security incident within the period and under the conditions determined by the Authority.
